reviews.text: Truly amazing service. I have worked with many other pool companies in the past, but none come close to Castro and his team. The  punctuality , honesty, and kindness with answer any questions I had were unmatched. What really sets them apart is that they care. They don’t just see another subscription — they see the impact a clean, well-balanced pool has on a family’s life. I’ll recommend these guys 10/10 times. Only the best here.
reviews.author: David Molina

reviews.text: Castro's pools did an amazing job from start to finish. The attention to detail was honestly much better than I expected. The final result left me with the biggest smile on my face. I highly recommend these guys for anyone shopping around !
reviews.author: Kathleen Tejada Reyes

reviews.text: We first learned of Castro’s from my brother who had a jacuzzi worked on. My brother praised this company and the time to complete the work. We had a pool pump go out, Castro’s came out, looked at our problem and gave us recommendations and suggestions. We replaced the pump! Great pricing and prompt service. We decided to hire them as our pool cleaning service, our pool hadn’t looked so clean! I mentioned that we needed a replaster, little did I know…we REALLY needed one! We did get a few estimates and this company was the most reasonable. So, we got a quote for a new skimmer, tile and plaster. During the rebuild, we found the light was taking in water, the jets had prior damage, deck o seal needed replacement and well, we wanted to update the steps. Work was done in a week even though we had 2 solid rain days. Communication was great! We love our new pool & are looking forward to the summer!
reviews.author: JNK Pedraza

reviews.text: Mr. Castro and his team did an excellent job building my pool, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The work was high quality, delivered with professionalism, and at very competitive prices. I continue to use their services for pool maintenance, and they always provide reliable and outstanding service. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Paloma Castro

reviews.text: Thank you for the hard work, and dependable timing, for the work you did for us. It looks great, and also a great pool company for the backyard. Our pool is 4yrs old, and never has had a issue. Always prompt returning calls. Highly recommend this company. 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩
reviews.author: Angela Marvicsin

reviews.text: These guys are always punctual, have strong communication and do a great job. The price is fair and it's very clear they have a wealth of knowledge and experience when it comes to pools. They've earned a customer for life..
reviews.author: Jariel Fernandez

reviews.text: Castro's Pool is awesome! Our pool was green and nothing we tried fixed the problem. Called Castro's Pool and they came the very next day. They gave us all our options and we decided to change the filter unit and convert our pool to salt. Noob was done quick, the price reasonable and within a day we were able to enjoy the pool once again.  They are very honest and hardworking. Best of all, they know what they are doing.
reviews.author: Elva Trevino

reviews.text: Castro's pool and general contractors  Co is one in best company in DFW  there ara contrición new pool and that do nice work and complete all work that  Mr castro said to do thank Mr Castro  for your hard working in my property. Blanca. Orellana
